import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import cmath

def task_func(x, y):
    if not isinstance(x, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(y, np.ndarray):
        raise TypeError("x and y must be numpy.ndarray instances.")
    if len(x) != len(y):
        raise ValueError("x and y must have the same length.")

    x_vals = np.asarray(x)
    y_vals = np.asarray(y)

    X, Y = np.meshgrid(x_vals, y_vals)
    phase_values = np.vectorize(
        lambda real, imag: cmath.phase(complex(real, imag)),
        otypes=[float],
    )(X, Y)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    if phase_values.size:
        mesh = ax.pcolormesh(x_vals, y_vals, phase_values, shading="auto", cmap="twilight")
        fig.colorbar(mesh, ax=ax, label="Phase")
    ax.set_xlabel("x")
    ax.set_ylabel("y")
    ax.set_title("Phase plot")
    return ax, phase_values
